title: 第3章 仙笼与面具第4章 加倍奉还
content_zh:
武皇朝之南的荒州地域辽阔，镇守着四大人族禁区之一的死寂荒原，大荒城是荒州最大的城市，也是荒州的权利中心，聚集着以人族为首数以千万的生灵。
荒州三大诸侯都在大荒城境内。
而余氏是三大诸侯中，实力最强，传承最悠久的一脉，光是那座余侯府就占据着连绵一片的辽阔土地，宫殿楼台鳞次栉比，生活着近十万余氏族人。
靠近侯府后山，有一块地方名为冷院，属于府内最偏僻荒凉的地段，曾是软禁余氏罪人的地方，人踪罕至，那里甚至连府内最下等的仆人都不愿意去。
月上柳梢头，一身黑袍的余烬，就站在冷院门外，入目破墙旧瓦，院内的老梧桐秋叶飘零，他从小长大的冷院，似乎还是跟三年前一样的冷清。
他推门而入，目光迅速扫过院子之内，一个闪身便消失在原地。
“小蝶还没回来……”余烬在冷院各处转了一圈，那漆黑的双瞳之中突然闪过一丝异样。
下一秒，他猛地抬头，月光从云间洒落，黑袍下的少年脸庞清晰地呈现，那是一张十六七岁的年轻面孔，脸上没有少年那股稚嫩，长相算不是俊美可五官棱角分明如同刀削，尤其是那双眸子深邃得让人讶异。
少年脸上忽然出现一丝痛苦神情。
“反噬来的越来越凶猛了……”他伸出手掌，那奇异的漆黑色火焰纹路再次从手臂上浮现，瞬间蔓延了整只手掌！
下一秒，空气中的温度陡然充斥起难言的炙热感，仿佛整个空间都要开始沸腾，而余烬全身每一寸皮肤的毛孔开始急速扩大，豆大的汗珠滚落，他的身体里的传来噼里啪啦的声响，似乎有什么在死死地勒紧他的骨头，要将它们一寸寸磨成粉碎！
“呼……一定要在小蝶回来之前清醒过来，千万不能吓到她……”承受着某种反噬的余烬擦了擦汗水，那黑眸中却始终保持着一丝清明，他开始盘膝坐下，然后缓缓闭起双眼。
片刻之后，空气中突然有着如同水纹一般的涟漪震动，少年胸前奇妙地出现一团奇异光芒，一座巴掌大小造型古朴的奇异竹笼，悬浮其中！
竹笼轻轻摇动，上面流淌着神秘古老的符文，而内部竟是一团仿佛浑浊漆黑的黑暗世界！
少年如有所感，心念一动之间，下一息便出现在笼中的漆黑世界当中，在吐出一口长长的浊气之后，他脚步往前轻轻一踏，漆黑涌动，周围的黑暗如同黑雾般吹散而去。
突然，前面出现一座高耸怪异的山峦，余烬抬眼望去，那骇然是一头巨大的古老的恐怖生灵！
那生灵如雀，身躯匍匐在地，浑身长满如火焰般的羽毛，一对暗红羽翼收拢在身躯两侧，哪怕它双目紧闭似在沉睡，可周身散发着的那股强大、危险又古老的气息，依旧让人心悸无比！
“你再看无数次，这不死雀也不会苏醒，除非你能想办法再觅机缘，可惜道种被毁，伤及本源，你……恐怕是此生无望了。”一张笑脸面具，从空中飘落下来，悬浮在了古老生灵上方。
余烬看向那神秘笑脸，冷声道：“你不说话，没人当你是哑巴。”
神秘笑脸发出光芒，像是在嘲讽，“仙笼的反噬不好受吧，三年前你道种被毁，重伤垂死，要不是遇上本尊赐予了你无上修行法，让你激活了不死雀血脉获得了一丝力量，你会活过来么？”

“不死雀本来就属于我！”余烬握紧拳头，手掌上的黑焰纹路越发狰狞，骨头传来的痛楚像是要把他整个人撕裂，“仙笼亦是因此才会认我为主，你被困于仙笼，出手救我也只是想得到自由罢了！”
嘭！
神秘笑脸突破空间桎梏，瞬移般出现在余烬眼前，一人一面具仿佛在对视，半响之后面具里传出肆意笑声，“哈哈哈……你当本尊是囚犯是吗！？本尊脚踏天地之时，你所处的此方世界还尚是一粒沧海微尘，若不是因那一剑……”
“少在那里编神话故事！”余烬冷笑一声。
可那笑脸却话锋一转，笑道：“小蝼蚁，不要试图激怒本尊，按照你我之间的契约，你的时间可不多了！”
面具上突然出现某种契约符号，余烬摊开手掌，同样的符号也在其手心闪烁！
他能感觉到符号正以微不可察的速度消逝，根据面具的说法，这是神契，成立之后契约双方互同生死！
而一旦手心的符号彻底消散，对方会吞噬他的灵魂！
这是当年他活过来的代价！
他的时间的确不多了，三年……或者只有两年！
笑脸面具缓缓升高，那双空洞又邪异的眼睛俯瞰着少年，“你方才在那大殿之中作死，是想借助本尊的力量杀人，你真当本尊是免费打手？”
余烬脸上轻描淡写，“神契在，你我互同生死，帮我就是在帮你。”
“贪婪的小蝼蚁，哪怕进入生命的倒计时也想要利用本尊，可惜神明的力量非凡躯能驾驭……”笑脸面具发出的邪异笑声越发张狂，“凡有所获，必有所失！”
余烬的身体明明因为痛苦而颤栗，眼神却逐渐平静下来，“除了娘亲和小蝶，这世上我没什么害怕失去的，哪怕是命……”
“啧啧……”面具的笑声充满讥讽，“仙笼虽然认主，可你实力太弱太弱，你的凡躯根本压不住仙力反噬，哪怕是一丝一缕，也让你每天都在遭受磨骨噬肉之痛，虽然不死雀黑焰的治愈能力能一定程度压制你的痛楚，可还远远不够，你居然还不知死活地在那大殿之上，欲借助黑焰御敌，你是嫌反噬的不够厉害……”
余烬面对嘲讽，忽然笑了起来，“我打架向来喜欢拼命，我也只能拼命了，命我都可以不要，为什么要怕仙笼的反噬……”
离开荒城三年，每一天都在生死中徘徊，除了一条命，少年一无所有！
面具里沉默了一下，像是想起什么，片刻后才发出一声冷哼，“哼，你要怎么疯，本尊懒得理会，我劝你还是尽快找到突破第二境的方法，不然等不到神契符印消散，你就会被外面那群蝼蚁撕成碎片，别指望本尊帮你！”
话音落下，余烬的眼前黑雾像潮水一般汹涌而来，阴冷的气息布满每一寸空间，余烬心念一动，下一秒直接退出了仙笼世界！
黑雾淹没了少年原先所在的位置，神秘的笑脸面具缓缓漂浮，落在了不死雀的头颅之上，仙笼世界里响起喃喃自语。

“你可是万族生灵梦寐以求的无上至宝，为什么要认他为主……就因为真灵不死雀吗……可蝼蚁的气运再大，也终究是蝼蚁……”
“你困了本尊多少年了，久到本尊自己都忘记了，因为你本尊才会许下神契，既然你选了他……要不，这一次我们打一个赌，若是之后他烟消云散，你便不要再有阻拦，一心一意臣服于本尊，可好？”
笑脸面具上微光闪烁，可仙笼内却没有任何回应，那片漆黑的迷雾世界，依旧阴冷如常。
content_en:
The Huangzhou to the south of the Wu Dynasty is vast, guarding the Dead Wasteland, one of the four human race restricted areas. Dahuang City is the largest city in the Huangzhou and the center of power in the Huangzhou. It is home to tens of millions of creatures led by the human race.
The three major princes of Huangzhou are all within the territory of Dahuang City.
Among the three major princes, the Yu family is the strongest and has the longest inheritance. The Yuhou Mansion alone occupies a vast stretch of land, with rows of palaces and towers, and nearly 100,000 clan members living there.
Close to the back hill of the Hou Mansion, there is a place called Lengyuan, which is the most remote and desolate area in the manor. It was once the place where Yu's criminals were placed under house arrest. It is so inaccessible that even the lowest servants in the manor are unwilling to go there.
On the top of the willow tree in the moonlight, Ember, dressed in a black robe, stood outside the door of Lengyuan. He saw broken walls and old tiles, and the autumn leaves of the old sycamores in the courtyard were falling. The Lengyuan where he grew up seemed to be as deserted as three years ago.
He pushed the door open, glanced quickly across the courtyard, and disappeared in a flash.
"Xiaodie hasn't come back yet..." Yu Ji walked around the cold courtyard, and something strange suddenly flashed in his dark eyes.
The next second, he suddenly raised his head, the moonlight fell from the clouds, and the face of the young man under the black robe was clearly revealed. It was a young face of sixteen or seventeen years old. His face did not have the immature look of a young man. His appearance was not handsome, but his features were as sharp as knives, especially his eyes, which were so deep that it was surprising.
A look of pain suddenly appeared on the young man's face.
"The backlash is getting more and more fierce..." He stretched out his palm, and the strange black flame pattern emerged from his arm again, spreading to the entire palm in an instant!
The next second, the temperature in the air suddenly filled with an unspeakable hot feeling, as if the whole space was about to boil, and the pores of every inch of Hu Yan's skin began to expand rapidly, big beads of sweat rolled down, and there was a crackling sound in his body, as if something was tightening his bones, grinding them into pieces inch by inch!
"Huh... we must wake up before Xiaodie comes back, and we must not scare her..." Ember, who was suffering from some kind of backlash, wiped his sweat, but there was always a trace of clarity in his black eyes. He began to sit down cross-legged, and then slowly closed his eyes.
A moment later, there were ripples in the air that were like water ripples. A strange light appeared on the boy's chest, and a palm-sized bamboo cage with a simple shape was suspended in it!
The bamboo cage shook gently, with mysterious ancient runes flowing on it, but inside was a dark world that seemed to be turbid and pitch-black!
If the young man felt something, with a thought, the next breath appeared in the dark world in the cage. After exhaling a long breath of turbid air, he stepped forward lightly, the darkness surged, and the surrounding darkness blew away like black mist.
Suddenly, a tall and strange mountain appeared in front of him. When Yi Yan raised his eyes, he saw that it was a huge ancient terrifying creature!
The creature was like a bird, prostrate on the ground, covered with flame-like feathers, and a pair of dark red wings folded on both sides of the body. Even though it had its eyes closed tightly and seemed to be sleeping, the powerful, dangerous and ancient aura exuding around it still made people feel heart-stopping!
"If you watch it countless times, this immortal bird will not wake up, unless you can find a way to find another opportunity. Unfortunately, the Tao seed has been destroyed and the source has been damaged. You... I am afraid there is no hope in this life." A smiling mask fell from the air and hovered above the ancient creature.
Yi Yan looked at the mysterious smiling face and said coldly: "If you don't speak, no one will think you are mute."
The mysterious smile glowed, as if taunting, "Don't you feel the backlash from the Immortal Cage? Three years ago, your Taoism was destroyed and you were seriously injured and dying. If you hadn't met me and given you the supreme practice method, allowing you to activate the bloodline of the immortal bird and gain a little strength, would you have survived?"
"The immortal bird is originallyTo me! "Yi Yan clenched his fists, and the black flame lines on his palms became more and more ferocious. The pain from his bones seemed to tear his whole body apart, "That's why the Immortal Cage recognized me as its master. You were trapped in the Immortal Cage, and you just wanted to be free when you rescued me! "
Bang!
The mysterious smiling face broke through the shackles of space and appeared in front of Yu Yan like a teleport. One person and one mask seemed to be looking at each other. After a while, wanton laughter came from the mask, "Hahaha... You think I am a prisoner, don't you? ? When I stepped on the heaven and earth, the world you were in was still a speck of dust in the ocean. If it weren't for that sword..."
"Stop making up fairy tales! "Ember sneered.
But the smiling face changed the topic and said with a smile: "Little ant, don't try to anger me. According to the contract between you and me, you don't have much time! "
A certain contract symbol suddenly appeared on the mask. Ember opened his palms, and the same symbol flashed in his palms!
He could feel the symbols disappearing at an imperceptible speed. According to the mask, this was a divine contract. After it was established, both parties to the contract would live and die together!
And once the symbol on the palm of his hand completely dissipates, the other party will devour his soul!
This was the price he paid for surviving back then!
He does not have much time left, three years...or only two years!
The smiling mask slowly lifted up, and those hollow and evil eyes looked down at the young man, "You just committed suicide in that hall because you wanted to use my power to kill people. Do you really think that I am a free thug?" "
Yu Yan said lightly, "There is a divine bond. You and I live and die together. If you help me, I am helping you. "
"Greedy little ant, even if the countdown to life is about to begin, you still want to use me, but it's a pity that the power of the gods cannot be controlled by the extraordinary body..." The evil laughter coming from the smiling mask became more and more crazy, "Everything you gain, you must lose! "
Yu Yan's body was obviously trembling with pain, but his eyes gradually calmed down, "Except for my mother and Xiaodie, there is nothing in this world that I am afraid of losing, even my life..."
"Tsk tsk..." The mask's laughter was full of sarcasm, "Although the immortal cage recognizes its master, you are too weak. Your mortal body cannot suppress the backlash of the immortal power. Even a trace of it will make you suffer from bone-grinding and flesh-gnawing pain every day. It hurts. Although the healing power of the Black Flame of the Immortal Bird can suppress your pain to a certain extent, it is not enough. You are still living and breathing in that hall, trying to use the Black Flame to defend yourself against the enemy. You think the backlash is not strong enough..."
Faced with the ridicule, Yu Yan suddenly laughed, "I always like to fight with all my might when fighting. I can only fight with all my strength. I don't have to take my life, so why should I be afraid of the backlash from the Immortal Cage..."
After leaving the deserted city for three years, he wandered between life and death every day. Except for his life, the young man had nothing!
The mask was silent for a moment, as if remembering something, and then he snorted coldly after a moment, "Humph, why are you going crazy? I don't care. I advise you to find a way to break through the second realm as soon as possible. Otherwise, you will be torn into pieces by the swarm of ants outside before the divine contract talisman dissipates. Don't expect me to help you!" "
As soon as he finished speaking, the black mist surged in front of Yu Yan's eyes like a tide, and the cold breath filled every inch of space. With a thought in his mind, Yu Yan exited the world of Immortal Cage in the next second!
The black mist submerged the boy's original location. The mysterious smiling mask floated slowly and landed on the head of the immortal bird. Mutterings resounded in the fairy cage world.
"You are the supreme treasure that all living creatures dream of. Why do you accept him as your master... just because of the immortal bird... But no matter how lucky an ant is, he will still be an ant after all..."
"You have been trapping me for so many years. It has been so long that I have forgotten that it was because of you that I made the divine contract. Since you chose him... How about we make a bet this time. If he disappears in the future, you will no longer have any obstacles and surrender to me wholeheartedly, okay? "
Glimmer on smiley maskIt flickered, but there was no response from the fairy cage. The dark misty world remained as cold as ever.
